trials.claim: Lifetime access to Easy Text Marketing Platform on 1 Code tier
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to Easy Text Marketing Platform
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
trials.reasoning: Buyers report receiving no access after purchase and the platform and tutorial page being inaccessible, which directly conflicts with promised lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: No access ⛔. I purchased the product yesterday! No access untill now!!!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving no access after purchase, directly contradicting lifetime access promise.

exhibits.quote: The platform isn't working as expected, and the tutorial page hasn't been accessible for a long time.
exhibits.argument: Report of platform not working and resources inaccessible undermines guaranteed lifetime access.

trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited messaging (with your gateway connected)
- Unlimited voice broadcasts (with your gateway connected)
- Unlimited groups
- Unlimited keywords
trials.reasoning: Buyers report they could not use any gateway or send any messages and that the gateway is missing, so unlimited messaging with a gateway connected was not usable as claimed.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't use any gateway, I couldn't send any messages, I couldn't even upload a single contact.
exhibits.argument: Buyer could not use any gateway or send messages, contradicting unlimited messaging with gateway connected.

exhibits.quote: this product doesn't work as advertised the gateway is missing the agency section is missing as well.
exhibits.argument: Gateway reported missing means unlimited messaging feature cannot be used as claimed.

trials.claim: Up to 50 team member accounts included sharing gateway
trials.claimQuote:
Up to 50 team member accounts included (sharing your gateway)
- Use With Twilio, Plivo, Bandwidth, SignalWire, Telnyx, Nexmo, and Ytel or your SMPP gateway
trials.reasoning: Reports that the gateway and agency section are missing and that no gateway could be used materially prevent team accounts from sharing a gateway as promised.

exhibits.quote: this product doesn't work as advertised the gateway is missing the agency section is missing as well.
exhibits.argument: Missing gateway and agency section prevents sharing gateway across team member accounts as promised.

exhibits.quote: I couldn't use any gateway, I couldn't send any messages, I couldn't even upload a single contact.
exhibits.argument: Inability to use any gateway undermines claim of team accounts sharing your gateway.

trials.claimQuote:
Email opt-in & lead notifications
- Email to SMS replies
- 25 Resellable Client Account Licenses
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports the agency section is missing, which directly undermines the ability to use resellable client account licenses; the other review only says reselling would be hard.

exhibits.quote: I Purchased the product and then retuned it back, the idea was to resell to my clients which is going to be hard
exhibits.argument: Buyer found reselling to clients impractical due to UI and setup, undermining resellable licenses value.

exhibits.quote: this product doesn't work as advertised the gateway is missing the agency section is missing as well.
exhibits.argument: Missing agency section directly contradicts ability to use resellable client account licenses.

themes.summary: Many buyers say support is fast, helpful, and goes beyond expectations.

Oh, and I forgot to mention how great their support team is.
Not only is the software powerful and flexible, but the support is next level.
The support team is fantastic.
Mat responded SUPER quickly and took the time to get me all set up and ready to go.
Matt always gets back to me within 24 hours i went with the agency platform and for me its 5 TACO's ALL THE WAY!!!!

themes.summary: Several users say the platform is easy to use and works well for SMS marketing.

hits.quote: I use the MLS number as the keyword, and it works perfectly!
The platform is easy to use and set up, making it accessible even for those who are not tech-savvy.
In both ways it is useful and far easier to navigate than Twiloio, which I have used previously but find challenging to navigate.
The platform is the best I used, and I purchased a couple but nothing comes close to Easy Text Agency Platform when it comes to features, robustness and support.
They are simple to set up and use.
